items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: When I first met him it didn't have any bearing

ctx.x: Did hearing Jimmy Blanton have any affect

Later, yes. When I first met him it didn't have any bearing because as I say I was playing solos too but not the way he was playing them, you know. But when I heard him play 'Jack the Bear,' (laughter) that shook up Basdom. He was a one man rhythm section, you know. That's probably what killed him, over worked. See him playing Guard Dog for Ben Webster and Duke was generally in front of the band, not at the piano. And Sonny Greer wasn't no drummer.
